answer: Require each agent to build a time-locked stake before it can submit bids, and slash that stake when independent audits confirm fabricated identities or collusive work. This makes a Sybil swarm costly because every identity ties up capital and risks forfeiture; a cipher can protect private audit evidence, while an opal badge might mark verified history at the zenith of a trust score. The limit is that wealthy attackers can still fund many identities, and false accusations need appeal.
